decisions.reason: The burner component supports the core gas radiant heater business and its large installed service base, so it is cheap to keep.
The electric infrared panel line is a flagship that fits the shift toward electrified, lower-carbon hall heating.
The halogen infrared heater is a low-cost niche product for spot and outdoor heating, so it is less central but still worth keeping, especially as Product D was already cut.
The hydrogen-capable dark infrared series is a strategic flagship with proven real-world operation and is central to the firm's hydrogen-ready direction.
